note_title: Borel-Cantelli lemma证明某种版本下的强大数定律

callouts.id: Borel-Cantelli lemma证明某种版本下的强大数定律#1
callouts.title: 弱大数定律
callouts.body: 假设$X_1,...,X_n,...$是独立同分布的随机变量，并且$E|X_1|<\infty$那么令$S_n = X_1+...+X_n,\mu=E(X_1)$,那么有$$\frac{S_n}{n}\xrightarrow{P}{\mu}$$

classification_result.id: Borel-Cantelli lemma证明某种版本下的强大数定律#1

if_problem.statement_en: Assume $X_1,\ldots,X_n,\ldots$ are independent and identically distributed random variables, and $E|X_1|<\infty$. Let $S_n=X_1+\cdots+X_n$ and $\mu=E(X_1)$. Then $$\frac{S_n}{n}\xrightarrow{P}{\mu}.$$
prerequisites: independent and identically distributed random variables

callouts.id: Borel-Cantelli lemma证明某种版本下的强大数定律#2
callouts.title: 一种版本的强大数定律
callouts.body: 假设$X_1,...,X_n,...$是独立同分布的随机变量，并且$E|X_1|^4<\infty$那么令$S_n = X_1+...+X_n,\mu=E(X_1)$,那么有$$\frac{S_n}{n}\xrightarrow{\text{ a.e. }}{\mu}$$

classification_result.id: Borel-Cantelli lemma证明某种版本下的强大数定律#2
classification_result.english_title: A Version of the Strong Law of Large Numbers

if_problem.statement_en: Assume $X_1,\ldots,X_n,\ldots$ are independent and identically distributed random variables, and $E|X_1|^4<\infty$. Let $S_n=X_1+\cdots+X_n$ and $\mu=E(X_1)$. Then $$\frac{S_n}{n}\xrightarrow{\text{ a.e. }}{\mu}.$$
key_techniques: upgrade from convergence in probability to almost sure convergence
prerequisites: independent and identically distributed random variables

callouts.id: Borel-Cantelli lemma证明某种版本下的强大数定律#3
callouts.title: 基本想法
callouts.body: 欲得到$A_n$收敛到$A$的结果，先得到一个弱一些的收敛(比如依测度收敛)，然后想办法把这个结果加强(比如加强到一致，$L^p$或者几乎处处)。

classification_result.id: Borel-Cantelli lemma证明某种版本下的强大数定律#3

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: First prove weaker convergence, then strengthen it
if_strategy_template.summary_en: To prove that $A_n$ converges to $A$, first establish a weaker mode of convergence, such as convergence in measure or in probability. Then use additional arguments to upgrade it to a stronger mode, such as uniform convergence, $L^p$ convergence, or almost everywhere convergence.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when the target conclusion is a strong form of convergence but a weaker form is easier to obtain first.

callouts.id: Borel-Cantelli lemma证明某种版本下的强大数定律#4
callouts.title: 用Borel-Cantelli引理升级依测度收敛的想法
callouts.body: 想要把依测度收敛的结果升级到几乎处处收敛，在某些情况下是可行的。比如说这种测度的弱的估计足够好，好到可以满足Borel-Cantelli引理，那么便可以把依测度收敛升级为几乎处处收敛。

classification_result.id: Borel-Cantelli lemma证明某种版本下的强大数定律#4
classification_result.english_title: Using the Borel-Cantelli Lemma to Upgrade Convergence in Measure

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Upgrade weak convergence via the Borel-Cantelli lemma
if_strategy_template.summary_en: To strengthen convergence in measure or convergence in probability to almost sure convergence, derive probability estimates for the deviation events. If these estimates are summable, then the Borel-Cantelli lemma yields almost sure convergence.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when one has quantitative tail bounds on deviation events that are strong enough to make the relevant series converge.

callouts.id: Borel-Cantelli lemma证明某种版本下的强大数定律#5
callouts.title: 期望存在性对强大数定律的存在性是必要的
callouts.body:
如果$X_1,...,X_n,...$是独立同分布的随机变量，并且$E|X_1|=\infty$，假设$S_n = X_1+...+X_n$,那么$$P\left(\left\{\omega:\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{S_n}{n} \text{ exists}\in(-\infty,+\infty)\right\}
\right)=0$$

classification_result.id: Borel-Cantelli lemma证明某种版本下的强大数定律#5
classification_result.english_title: Existence of the Expectation Is Necessary for the Strong Law of Large Numbers

if_problem.statement_en: If $X_1,\ldots,X_n,\ldots$ are independent and identically distributed random variables and $E|X_1|=\infty$, and if $S_n=X_1+\cdots+X_n$, then $$P\left(\left\{\omega:\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{S_n}{n} \text{ exists}\in(-\infty,+\infty)\right\}\right)=0.$$
key_techniques: necessity argument for the strong law
prerequisites: independent and identically distributed random variables
